releases.name: M8 image asset management (beta)
releases.summary: Ship M8 image asset management as a beta pre-release: portable asset copying, inlined rendering and export, a visible missing-asset state, drag/drop import and image-local controls, plus the two blocking defects a pre-release slop-ferret sweep verified — startup no longer fails on an unreadable preference store, and image resolution is pinned on every render surface. A 2026-08-08 ABORT review of promoting this to a non-beta release returned NO-GO on all five stations; the data-destruction and correctness-gate findings are fixed and recorded here, and the remaining conditions live in docs/releases/v0.4.0-abort.md.
